candidates.original_title: Perceiving numbers causes spatial shifts of attention
candidates.description: Participants are quicker to detect left-side targets when preceded by small numbers and quicker to detect right-side targets when preceded by large numbers (the Att-SNARC effect).
candidates.citation_sentence: We attempted to replicate Experiment 2 of Fischer et al. by collecting data from 1,105 participants at 17 labs.
